12.description: Parque Canino da Serra das Brancas on Avenida Luís Sá in Amadora is a fenced area where dogs can exercise and socialise off lead under their owners' supervision. Water is available. Check the gates, pick up after your dog and be mindful of the other dogs using the park.

13.description: Paladar Restaurante in central Seia welcomes dogs indoors. Its contemporary Portuguese cuisine combines traditional flavours with modern dishes, including fish, meat, risottos and regional desserts. A dining option with your dog after exploring Seia or Serra da Estrela.

14.description: Olive Lisbon, now at Rua do Comércio 54 in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors. Its all-day menu includes bowls, salads, burgers, fish and vegetarian options. The downtown location is near Praça do Comércio and the riverside, handy for a meal during a walk with your dog.

15.description: Mister Tapas Grill in Massamá, Sintra, welcomes dogs indoors. The informal restaurant specialises in tapas, small plates and charcoal-grilled meats with Iberian and Latin American influences, alongside cocktails and desserts.

16.description: Miami Mami by Avenida Marginal in Estoril welcomes dogs indoors and outdoors, with water available. Its beach-brunch concept includes bowls, egg dishes, burgers, salads and gluten-free choices, close to Poça, Azarujinha and Tamariz beaches.

17.description: Cerveja Canil on Rua dos Douradores in downtown Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors and provides water. This craft beer bar serves a broad selection of draught beers alongside tapas and light bites, making it a relaxed stop with your dog in the historic centre.

18.description: CONDE13 Rooftop Bar & Restaurant on Rua do Conde de Redondo in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. Part of an aparthotel, the venue combines a café, restaurant and rooftop with all-day brunch, meals and drinks near Marquês de Pombal.

19.description: Viseu Garden Hotel in Vermum–Campo, near Viseu, accepts pets in guest rooms. Public booking information currently lists a fee of €10 per pet per night; confirm the current rate and any restrictions directly with the hotel. It offers convenient access to central Viseu.

20.description: Lounge by CAFELAB on Avenida de Moçambique in Oeiras welcomes dogs indoors. This brunch café serves house recipes, speciality coffee, comforting dishes and craft beer, including a coffee-infused creation. Dogs should remain accompanied during the visit.

21.description: Treestory Restaurant on Rua Luciano Cordeiro in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. Known for Georgian cuisine, it serves khinkali, khachapuri, stews and grilled meats alongside Georgian wines. The venue also has a leafy terrace, but check whether dogs may use that area.

22.description: The Vibe in Alverca do Ribatejo welcomes dogs indoors and provides water. Its all-day brunch and light-food menu includes bowls, bagels, toast and pancakes, making it a relaxed café for breakfast, lunch or a break with your dog.

23.description: W Algarve Hotel & Residences in Sesmarias, Albufeira, accepts one dog or cat per room, weighing no more than 15 kg. A non-refundable €130 pet fee applies. Pets can stay in the room and permitted areas, and water is available. Near Galé and Evaristo beaches, the hotel offers pools, a spa and restaurants; confirm which areas pets may enter.

25.description: D’Alena at Miradouro do Alto do Relógio in Loulé welcomes small, calm dogs indoors. Dogs must remain properly controlled throughout the visit. The restaurant serves contemporary Portuguese and Algarve-inspired dishes, including small plates, meat and fish, in an elevated setting overlooking Loulé.

26.description: Parque Canino Largo da Lagoa in Linda-a-Velha is a fenced dog park where dogs can run and play off lead, with water available. Oeiras council announced a temporary closure for repairs in April 2025, so check that the park has reopened before visiting.

27.description: Praia do Coral in Viana do Castelo is a beach designated for visitors with dogs, beside Avenida de Cabo Verde. Sheltered between two breakwaters, it offers a coastal spot to enjoy with your dog. Keep your dog under control and bring bags to collect waste.

28.description: Pastelaria Tinoco in Linda-a-Velha welcomes dogs on the terrace only; they are not allowed indoors. Founded in 1973, this neighbourhood pastry shop is known for cakes and pastéis de nata, making it a good coffee stop with your dog in Oeiras.

29.description: Hemisfério in Oeiras welcomes dogs indoors and provides water for them. This brunch café and bar serves coffee and brunch by day, followed by drinks and cocktails later on, making it an easy place to visit with your dog.

30.description: Restaurante Peixarada, on Largo da Barca in Portimão, allows dogs indoors provided they are not large. Specialising in fish and seafood, it serves dishes such as grilled fish, cod and seafood rice. If you have a large dog, contact the restaurant before visiting to confirm whether it can be accommodated.

31.description: Mugs Brunch Coffee in Magoito, near Sintra, welcomes dogs indoors. Close to Praia do Magoito, this café serves brunch, coffee and lighter dishes, including healthy and vegetarian options, making it a convenient stop with your dog.

32.description: Xarme Restaurante & Bar in Portimão welcomes only small, quiet dogs indoors. Dogs of any size are allowed on the outdoor terrace. The restaurant serves international dishes and has a bar atmosphere, with regular events and live music. Choose the terrace if your dog is larger or may be noisy.

33.description: Umbra Domes in Vila Nova de Famalicão is a nature retreat welcoming up to two dogs per stay, including large breeds. Dogs can stay inside the accommodation and explore the 16-hectare estate, but must be kept on a lead in shared areas where other people or dogs are present. There is an additional €20 per night pet fee. The retreat offers a jacuzzi, trails and places to relax in the Minho countryside.

34.description: Roots Aljezur, on Rua 25 de Abril in Aljezur, is a café and restaurant welcoming dogs indoors. Its fully vegan menu focuses on fresh, healthy food such as sweet potato waffles, açaí and granola bowls, seasonal soups, salads, sugar-free cakes and gluten-free choices. It is a useful place for breakfast, brunch or lunch with your dog in central Aljezur.

35.description: Amunì Caffè, near Praia da Rocha in Portimão, allows dogs indoors. Inspired by Sicily, the café serves coffee, brunch and ice cream. It is a convenient stop with your dog near the beach; keep your pet close so that people can move comfortably through the indoor space.

36.description: Pizzaria Acqua e Sale in Tavira welcomes dogs indoors and usually offers them water and biscuits. The restaurant specialises in Italian cuisine, including pizzas, pasta and freshly made pasta dishes. It is a welcoming option for lunch or dinner with your dog in Tavira.

37.description: Restaurante A Ponte, beside the waterfront in Portimão, welcomes dogs of any size both indoors and on its terrace. Its menu features Portuguese cooking and fish, with buffet and rodízio service on selected occasions. It is an easy option for a meal by the river with your dog.

38.description: Hotel Inglaterra in Estoril, Cascais, accepts dogs in guest rooms without a fixed size limit. The maximum number of dogs is decided case by case, and an extra €15 per night applies. At present, dogs may only move between the lobby and their room, so confirm the conditions when booking.

39.description: OK Burger, on Rua Alexandre Herculano in Areias de São João, Albufeira, welcomes dogs of any size on its terrace, with water and sometimes a treat available for them. It specialises in freshly prepared smash burgers made with Angus beef, brioche buns and toppings such as cheddar, bacon, pickles and house sauces. A vegetarian alternative is also available. Dogs are not permitted indoors.

40.description: Restaurante Encci in Carvoeiro, near Lagoa, welcomes dogs both indoors and outside as long as they are accompanied and kept on a lead. Its daytime menu includes brunch, bowls, fresh juices and coffee, while pizzas are a focus later in the day. Vegan and gluten-free options are also available. A convenient choice for breakfast, lunch or dinner with your dog in Carvoeiro.

41.description: Praia Fluvial de Alte, near Fonte Grande in Alte, in the municipality of Loulé, is a riverside leisure area where dogs may accompany their owners on a lead. The site has a natural swimming pool, picnic areas, shade and spaces for relaxing beside Ribeira de Alte. Dogs are not allowed in the pool or spring, or within the spring’s protected perimeter. Respect the posted rules when visiting this inland Algarve attraction with your dog.

42.description: Buona Serra Pizzaria in Queluz welcomes dogs indoors. The Italian restaurant serves artisan pizzas, pasta and lasagne, including vegetarian options, making it a place for lunch or dinner with your dog in the Sintra area.

43.description: Pet&Tea on Rua João Cabreira in downtown Coimbra is a cat café that welcomes pets indoors and on its terrace, provided they remain on a lead. Water bowls are available. The café supports responsible cat adoption, so visitors should respect the resident cats' welfare.

44.description: Restaurante Trama Pasta Fresca in downtown Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. Its speciality is fresh pasta made in-house, combining Italian recipes with influences from other cuisines, near Rua Augusta.

45.description: The Bread Box Burgers in Belverde, Seixal, welcomes dogs indoors and has a terrace that can be more convenient for larger animals. It specialises in freshly prepared artisan burgers.

46.description: Casa Nolita at Docas de Santo Amaro in Lisbon welcomes dogs of any size on its terrace only, not indoors. The Italian restaurant serves pizza, pasta and cocktails overlooking the Tagus.

47.description: Restaurante Botânico in Ferrarias, Almancil, welcomes well-behaved dogs indoors and provides water for them. Its contemporary menu includes meat, fish, vegan and gluten-free options, served in a setting surrounded by greenery. It is a pleasant choice for lunch or dinner with your dog near Almancil and Quinta do Lago, provided your pet remains calm during the meal.

48.description: Restaurante Retiro da Ponte in Vilar de Mouros, Caminha, welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace. Near the village's historic bridge, it serves Portuguese dishes with traditional and contemporary influences and seasonal produce.

49.description: Selllva on Rua Mouzinho da Silveira in Lisbon accepts dogs only in its outdoor seating area. The menu features brunch and internationally inspired healthy dishes, including vegetarian and vegan options, near Avenida da Liberdade.

50.description: Tasca Ju in Espinheiro, Alcanena, welcomes dogs both indoors and on its small terrace. This informal local tavern serves snacks and drinks and offers a friendly stop with your dog.

51.description: Dona Sardinha in Luso, Mealhada, welcomes dogs indoors and offers them biscuits. Near Parque do Lago, the restaurant serves creative vegetarian and vegan food in a peaceful green setting.

52.description: The Passadiços de Alvor boardwalks, near Portimão, offer an approximately six-kilometre, mostly flat route through the estuary, dunes and coastal landscape. Dogs can accompany walkers, but keeping them on a lead and remaining on the boardwalk are recommended to protect the ecosystem. There is little shade and the route can be busy on sunny days, so cooler hours are best.

53.description: Parque Canino de Olhão in Quelfes, in the municipality of Olhão, is a fenced dog park where dogs can run and play safely off-lead. The enclosure has a drinking fountain, benches and obstacles for activity and training. It is a useful place for exercise and socialisation with your dog in the eastern Algarve.

54.description: C&C Artesanal Food on Rua dos Cedros in Porto welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace. Dogs can move around the venue, and toys and treats are available. The pizzeria also has sofas, books and games for adults and children.

55.description: Gaia Organic Shop & Kitchen in Rogil, near Aljezur, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and in its spacious garden, provided they stay on a lead. Water is available for pets. The venue combines an organic grocery shop with plant-based food in a relaxed, nature-inspired atmosphere. It is a convenient stop for eating, shopping or spending time with your dog along the Vicentine Coast.

56.description: Forum Algarve in Faro allows dogs in its common areas on a short lead. Dogs cannot enter the food court or hypermarket, and individual shops may apply their own rules. Outside, a dog-friendly area has drinking water, a dog toilet and play equipment, which should be used under supervision. Leads and muzzles can also be borrowed from the information desk against a deposit. It is a useful place to shop with your dog in Faro.

58.description: Bipolar Restaurante in Cais do Sodré, Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and outdoors. Overlooking the Tagus, it serves brunch, lunch and dinner, offering a riverside meal with your dog.

59.description: Madrasta Restaurante in the municipal garden of Paço de Arcos welcomes dogs of any size on its terrace, but not indoors. Its Mediterranean-inspired menu includes Portuguese and Italian dishes, pizzas, pasta, fish and meat.

60.description: Alegro Alfragide shopping centre welcomes dogs in common areas and participating shops displaying the 'Bem-vindos Cãopanheiros' sign. Register at the information desk on your first visit and present the required documents for a dog passport. Up to two dogs per person may enter, on non-retractable leads no longer than one metre. Food courts, the hypermarket, toilets and unmarked shops are excluded. A dog toilet area is available.

61.description: Clube Royale on Rua do Poço dos Negros in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. The shop and creative studio focuses on vintage clothing, designer pieces and artistic projects, and also hosts music events.

62.description: Praia das Amoreiras in Santa Cruz, Torres Vedras, has an official dog-friendly area with animal shelters, drinking fountains and waste-bag dispensers. Keep your dog under control, follow the signs and carry the required documents.

63.description: Praia dos Pescadores (Praia Velha) in Paço de Arcos has a designated dog-friendly area open year-round. Facilities include a drinking fountain, dog-waste bag dispensers and regular cleaning. Dogs must stay on a lead, and owners must follow hygiene and identification rules.

64.description: Praia do Porto da Areia Norte in Peniche welcomes dogs throughout the year. Portugal's first officially designated dog beach has around 80 metres of sand and dog-waste bag dispensers. Stay within the marked area and follow the signs.

65.description: Quiosque Keil do Amaral on Alameda Keil do Amaral in Lisbon's Monsanto Forest Park has a dog-friendly outdoor terrace with water available for dogs. Serving coffee, burgers, bagels, toast, bowls and drinks, it is a convenient stop during a walk in Monsanto, with views over Lisbon.

68.description: Loures Shopping in Loures allows dogs on leads in the common areas. Dogs may not enter the food court or supermarket, and individual shops can set their own entry rules. Check the signs before going inside.

69.description: Churrasqueira Cruz de Portugal in Silves welcomes up to two dogs inside and also has an outdoor terrace. The restaurant specialises in Portuguese grilled food, including roast chicken and other dishes from the grill. The indoor dog policy is displayed at the entrance.

70.description: Aqua Portimão is a dog-friendly shopping centre in Portimão where dogs may walk on a lead in the common areas. They are not allowed in the food court or supermarket, and only certain shops permit dogs inside. Check the signs at each shop before entering with your pet.

73.description: The Flower Bar – Healthy Kitchen, on Rua Ataíde de Oliveira in Faro, welcomes dogs indoors provided they stay on a lead. Combining a café serving light, healthy food with a shop selling Portuguese handmade goods, flowers and home décor, it is a distinctive place for breakfast, lunch or a coffee break with your dog in Faro.

74.description: MAR Shopping Algarve in Almancil, near Loulé, allows dogs in the shopping centre’s common areas when accompanied by their owners. Dogs are not permitted in the food court or supermarket, and participating shops display signs indicating that pets may enter. The centre also has Woofland, a supervised dog-care area. Check each shop’s rules before entering with your dog.

75.description: Sunday in Lisbon on Largo Conde Barão welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on the terrace. Serving internationally inspired brunch dishes, eggs, toast and café favourites, it is an easy choice for a meal with your dog in Lisbon.

79.description: Kossie's Café Mouraria on Largo do Terreirinho in Lisbon welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors. This welcoming breakfast and brunch café offers eggs, toast, juices and açaí or yoghurt bowls, making it a handy stop while exploring Mouraria with your dog.

84.description: Parque Canino da Quinta do Caneco in Portimão is a fenced dog park where dogs can run and play off-lead. Always supervise your dog while using the enclosure.

89.description: Papoila Bar on Avenida 24 de Julho in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace, with water available for them. Known for signature cocktails and light bites, it is a relaxed option for an evening drink with your dog.

92.description: Kossie's Café Príncipe Real on Rua da Rosa in Lisbon welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors. This cosy speciality coffee and brunch café serves eggs, toast, juices and bowls, making it an easy stop for breakfast or brunch with your dog.

93.description: 5 Emotions in Portimão offers dog-friendly boat trips departing from Portimão Marina. Dogs are welcome on board without an extra charge; guests only need to let the operator know in advance that they will bring a dog. Excursions explore the Algarve coastline, including the Benagil caves and dolphin-watching trips. It is an appealing way to experience the coast with your dog.

94.description: M Café on Praça do Junqueiro in Carcavelos welcomes animals indoors provided they are accustomed to this kind of shared space. Water is available, and the café serves brunch and plant-based food, including pancakes, toast and cakes, not far from the beach.

95.description: Praça Beato in Lisbon's Beato neighbourhood welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors in the Refeitório restaurant and the Bakery and Brunch area. Set in a former industrial complex, the venue brings together Portuguese food, artisan baking, a grocery shop and a bar.

96.description: A Loba’Ma in Lisbon welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors. Serving food, brunch and drinks, it offers a convenient place to eat or relax with your dog, particularly when sitting outside is less comfortable.

97.description: The Coffee Corner in Campo de Ourique, Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors. This small speciality café serves breakfast options and sweet treats alongside espresso, flat whites and cold brew, making it a pleasant coffee stop with your dog.

100.description: Blue Ocean Trips, at Portimão Marina, allows dogs aboard its boat excursions along the Algarve coast. Trips include visits to the Benagil caves and sunset cruises. Confirm your chosen route and the onboard arrangements for your dog with the operator before booking.

101.description: Kohima in Lisbon's Parque das Nações welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace at lunchtime. This Portuguese-Indian fusion restaurant serves curries, naan, spice-led dishes and vegetarian choices, offering an option for dining with your dog in the area.

102.description: Monte do Cerro near Porto Covo welcomes up to two dogs per accommodation unit, for a fee of €20 per night. Dogs can stay inside the rural holiday houses, each with a fenced lawn or patio, close to the Alentejo coast.

103.description: Slow Sourdough Bakery in Charneca da Caparica welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace. This vegan artisan bakery specialises in sourdough bread, croissants, cinnamon rolls, focaccia and cakes.

104.description: Palacete do Guerreiro Charme Hotel & Spa in São Gião, Oliveira do Hospital, welcomes dogs in guest rooms and communal areas if they do not disturb other guests. Fees are €15 per day for one dog or €25 per day for two, with discounts for longer stays. Dog beds, food and water bowls and a welcome kit are available on request.

105.description: Praia Irmão on Praia do Castelo in Costa da Caparica welcomes well-behaved dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace. The beach restaurant and bar serves Mediterranean-inspired food, artisan pizzas and cocktails by the sea.

106.description: Ato Restaurante, on Rua do Albergue in Faro’s historic centre, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and has no terrace. Because the restaurant is small, guests are advised to give advance notice; admission depends on the dog’s behaviour and available space. Its contemporary cooking draws on seasonal Algarve ingredients. It is a distinctive option for dining with your dog in the heart of Faro.

107.description: Quinta da Ribeirinha in Paços de Gaiolo, Marco de Canaveses, welcomes dogs of any size in guest rooms without an extra fee. Inform the accommodation when booking. It offers suites, a swimming pool and views over the Douro River.

108.description: Lemon Drops, at Albufeira Marina, welcomes dogs of any size both indoors and on the terrace. Its menu includes breakfast, light meals, salads, hummus, vegetarian and vegan dishes, fish, seafood and traditional Algarve cataplana. Overlooking the marina, it is a relaxed place to enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner or a break with your dog in Albufeira.

109.description: Allboat, based at Albufeira Marina, allows dogs on its rigid inflatable boat excursions, with a maximum weight of 20 kg for safety and space reasons. Each dog is charged the equivalent of a child’s ticket. The trips explore the Albufeira coastline, caves and beaches, with dolphin watching included on some excursions. It offers an opportunity to discover the Algarve coast with a smaller dog.

110.description: Mistea Mountain on Rua Maria Eugénia Reis Ferreira Navarro in Sintra welcomes dogs indoors. Known as the town's first bubble tea shop, it also serves bubble waffles, mochi, coffee, Portuguese pastries and Asian snacks. A relaxed stop with your dog while exploring Sintra.

111.description: Comobå on Rua da Boavista in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. This bright, relaxed café and restaurant is known for brunch, coffee, matcha, pancakes, bowls and seasonal dishes, making it a convenient breakfast or lunch stop with your dog.

112.description: Malabarista Café in the Anjos neighbourhood of Lisbon welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on its terrace. Water and dog treats are available on request from the staff. The speciality coffee shop also serves breakfast, brunch, bagels and lighter dishes.

113.description: Capitão Nemo Algarve, departing from Parchal, allows dogs on its boat trips subject to advance confirmation. Acceptance depends on the dog’s size, available space and passenger numbers. Larger dogs must be discussed before booking and, if they occupy a seat, may be charged a child fare, particularly from May to September. Dogs should be sociable because there is a resident mascot on board. Trips include dolphin watching, Benagil caves, the Lagos coast and the Arade River.

114.description: Taberna La Popular in Ericeira welcomes dogs in all areas, provided they are accompanied by their owners and kept on a lead when needed. The welcoming tavern serves Spanish tapas, small plates and wine for a relaxed meal with your dog.

115.description: Capt. Tap in central Setúbal welcomes dogs of all sizes and other pets indoors. There is no terrace. The craft beer bar serves draught beers, bottled and canned choices, snacks and informal meals.

116.description: Soundwich in Porto's Parque da Cidade welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace and has a dedicated dog menu. It serves creative sandwiches, salads, burgers, artisan pizzas and brunch, making it a convenient stop after a park walk.

117.description: Flores da Pampa on Praça das Flores in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors; this is the only area available to them. The restaurant combines seasonal food, natural wines and live music in a relaxed setting, offering a place to eat or have a drink with your dog.

118.description: Pepe Verde Pizzeria Italiana in central Ericeira welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The Italian pizzeria serves handmade pizzas, including vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free alternatives, making it an easy stop for a relaxed meal with your dog.

119.description: Agora Restaurante in Lisbon welcomes dogs of any size both indoors and on its terrace. This makes it a convenient choice for lunch or dinner with your dog, whether you prefer to sit inside or outdoors.

120.description: Don Gull in Lagos welcomes up to four dogs in its indoor dining area and on the terrace. The restaurant serves creative fusion cuisine, sharing plates, meat and fish dishes, wines and cocktails. With both indoor and outdoor seating, it is a convenient choice for lunch or dinner with your dog in Lagos, subject to the four-dog limit.

121.description: BrunchMe Beach Club in Ericeira welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on its terrace. A maximum of five dogs may be inside at the same time. The relaxed seaside menu includes brunch, burgers, crêpes and salads, as well as special dog-friendly doughnuts from Cookas Cookies.

122.description: Casa dos 2 Pátios in Vila Nova de Milfontes welcomes dogs throughout the house without an extra fee. The two-bedroom accommodation has two fenced patios, outdoor dining and barbecue areas and is a short walk from the beach.

123.description: Galeria House of Wonders in central Cascais welcomes dogs throughout the venue, including indoors and on its terraces. This colourful vegetarian restaurant serves fresh dishes, juices and desserts, with a rooftop terrace for enjoying a meal alongside your dog.

124.description: Tony’s Pizza, at Quinta Shopping in Almancil, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace, with water and biscuits available for pets. The restaurant serves Italian dishes including freshly prepared pizzas, pasta, risotto, salads and desserts, along with breakfast options. Its informal, family-friendly setting makes it an easy choice for eating with your dog near Quinta do Lago.

125.description: Aldeia da Pedralva by WOT Signature, in the municipality of Vila do Bispo, offers dog-friendly accommodation in a restored village on the Vicentine Coast. Pets must be trained and accompanied and kept on a lead in shared areas, although they can be off-lead inside the guest room. A €25 daily pet fee and a €100 refundable security deposit apply, subject to any damage. It is a scenic base for exploring the western Algarve with your dog.

126.description: Hotel Horta da Moura near Monsaraz welcomes pets in rooms and communal areas, provided they are trained, accompanied and on a lead outside their room. A fee of €25 per day and a refundable €100 deposit apply, subject to no damage. The hotel has gardens and an outdoor pool.

127.description: WOT Sarrazola Soul in Colares, Sintra, accepts up to two domestic dogs or cats per room. A fee of €15 per pet per day and a refundable €100 deposit apply, subject to no damage. Pets must be accompanied or in a suitable carrier and kept on a lead in communal areas. They are not allowed in restaurants, bars, spas or swimming pools and must not be left alone overnight.

128.description: WOT Lagos Montemar Soul, on Rua da Torraltinha in Lagos, accepts dogs and cats, with a maximum of two pets per room. The fee is €15 per pet per day, plus a refundable €100 deposit if no damage occurs. Pets must be supervised or in a carrier and kept on a lead in shared areas. They are not allowed in restaurants, bars, spas or swimming pools and cannot be left alone overnight. It is an accommodation option near central Lagos and its beaches for guests travelling with pets.

129.description: WOT Pateira Soul in Fermentelos welcomes up to two dogs or cats per room, for a fee of €15 per pet per night and a refundable €100 deposit, subject to no damage. Pets must be accompanied or in carriers and kept on leads in common areas. They cannot enter the restaurant, bar, spa or pools or be left alone overnight.

130.description: WOT Lodge Soul in central Ericeira accepts up to two domestic dogs or cats per room, with a fee of €15 per pet per day and a refundable €100 deposit if there is no damage. Pets must be accompanied or in a suitable carrier and kept on a lead in communal areas. They cannot enter restaurants, bars, spas or pools or be left alone overnight.

131.description: WOT Ocean Soul opposite Praia das Maçãs near Sintra accepts up to two domestic dogs or cats per room. A fee of €15 per pet per day and a refundable €100 deposit apply, subject to no damage. Pets must be accompanied or in a suitable carrier and kept on a lead in communal areas. They cannot enter restaurants, bars, spas or pools or be left alone overnight.

132.description: WOT Nomad Social in the Picoas area of Lisbon accepts up to two domestic dogs or cats per room. There is a fee of €15 per pet per day and a refundable €100 deposit if no damage occurs. Pets must be accompanied or in a suitable carrier and kept on a lead in shared areas. They are not allowed in restaurants, bars, spas or swimming pools and must not be left alone overnight.

133.description: WOT Ericeira Surf Social welcomes up to two domestic dogs or cats in apartments, private rooms or shared rooms booked exclusively by one group. There is a charge of €15 per pet per day and a refundable €100 deposit, subject to no damage. Pets must be accompanied or in a suitable carrier, kept on a lead in communal areas and may not enter restaurants, bars, spas or pools. They must not be left alone overnight.

134.description: Fable – Books | Coffee | Community on Rua dos Prazeres in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. Combining an English-language bookshop with speciality coffee, light meals, natural wine and creative events, it is a welcoming place to browse, read or work with your dog nearby.

135.description: Hotel Octant Santiago in Santiago do Cacém accepts pets weighing up to 25 kg in guest rooms and has a terrace. A nightly supplement applies; confirm its amount and availability before booking. A pet welcome kit is provided.

136.description: Coffee in Brew on Rua Luciano Cordeiro in Lisbon welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on its terrace. This speciality coffee shop roasts its own beans and serves espresso, filter coffee, cold brew, breakfast and brunch. A good stop for coffee lovers exploring Lisbon with their dogs.

137.description: ULU Cascais in Quinta da Bicuda welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, with water and dog biscuits available. The café serves breakfast, brunch and lunch, as well as speciality coffee and natural wines, making it a relaxed place to eat with your dog in Cascais.

138.description: Páteo da Chica in Cano, Sousel, welcomes dogs of any size without a fixed number limit or extra fee. Dogs may stay in guest rooms and move throughout the house, but should not be left alone. Owners should take care near the pool, collect waste and take responsibility for damage.

139.description: Fábrica dos Óculos Lagos, on Rua dos Celeiros in Lagos, allows dogs inside its optical shop. The store offers optician and optometry services, prescription glasses, frames and sunglasses. It is a useful place to shop for eyewear or attend to your vision needs while your dog accompanies you indoors.

140.description: Villa Pedras del Rei in Santa Luzia, near Tavira, is dog-friendly accommodation accepting two to three dogs per stay without size restrictions. Dogs may stay inside and share the bedroom with their owners. A €350 security deposit is required per booking. Near Barril Beach and the Ria Formosa lagoon, it is a practical base for a holiday with dogs in the eastern Algarve.

141.description: Dear Breakfast Santos, on Calçada do Marquês de Abrantes in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on its terrace. The smallest branch of the café group serves all-day breakfast and brunch, with egg dishes, granola, pastries, coffee, juices and cocktails. A handy stop with your dog near Madragoa and the Santos waterfront.

142.description: Dear Breakfast Alfama, on Largo de Santo António da Sé in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on its terrace. Close to Lisbon Cathedral, the café serves breakfast and brunch throughout the day, including egg dishes, pancakes, coffee, juices and cocktails. It is a convenient stop with your dog while exploring Alfama's historic streets.

143.description: Dear Breakfast Chiado, on Calçada de São Francisco in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors. The café serves all-day breakfast and brunch, with egg dishes, coffee and fresh juices. A useful stop with your dog while exploring Chiado and downtown Lisbon.

144.description: Dear Breakfast Bica, on Rua das Gaivotas in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and outdoors. Serving breakfast and brunch throughout the day, it offers egg dishes, pancakes, granola, juices and cocktails. It is a convenient dog-friendly brunch stop in the Bica neighbourhood.

145.description: Quinta dos Capinhas in Porches, near Lagoa, welcomes dogs on its vineyard visits and wine-tasting experiences. Dogs must stay on a lead, and owners are responsible for keeping the property clean and safe. This family-run Algarve winery offers tastings, vineyard walks, picnics and buggy safaris. Visits are by advance booking, so confirm the arrangements for bringing your dog when reserving.

146.description: Botão Cervejaria Ericeira, on Rua Mendes Leal in central Ericeira, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors. Dogs can move around the venue except in the kitchen area. With its own craft beers and a menu of smoked meats such as pastrami, pulled pork and ribs, it is an option for eating out or enjoying a beer with your dog.

147.description: Botão Cervejaria in Carvoeira, Mafra, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on the terrace. Dogs may move around the premises except in the kitchen area. The brewery and restaurant specialises in house-brewed craft beer and smoked meats, including ribs, pastrami and burgers, offering an informal place to eat with your dog near Mafra.

148.description: Lagoa dos Mosqueiros in the Sintra hills is a peaceful place for a walk with your dog in nature. Within Sintra-Cascais Natural Park, the lagoon can be reached along several trails, including a walk of around 2.6 km from the Monserrate area. Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a lead. The wooded setting offers shade and a quieter alternative to some of Sintra's busier attractions.

149.description: Boa-Bao Lisboa, on Largo Rafael Bordalo Pinheiro in Chiado, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The menu explores Asian flavours inspired by Thailand, Vietnam, China, Japan, Korea and India, alongside signature cocktails and vegan and gluten-free options. It is a pet-friendly choice for lunch or dinner with your dog in central Lisbon.

150.description: Boa-Bao Porto on Rua da Picaria welcomes dogs indoors. This Asian-inspired restaurant serves dishes from several cuisines, signature cocktails and vegan and gluten-free options, making it a central Porto dining option with your dog.

151.description: HI Serra da Estrela in Penhas da Saúde, Covilhã, welcomes up to three dogs of any size per room. A fee of €5 per pet per night applies, and a small pet bed is provided. Rooms are compact, so consider the space available when bringing several dogs. The mountain accommodation sits at around 1,500 metres altitude.

152.description: Alma Veg in Carcavelos welcomes dogs of all sizes both indoors and on its terrace. This dog-friendly restaurant serves entirely vegan food, including bowls, salads, hummus and creative plant-based dishes, so you can enjoy a meal with your dog beside you.

153.description: Florista Íris in Senhora da Hora, Matosinhos, welcomes dogs indoors and provides water. This florist sells fresh flowers, plants, arrangements and botanical decorations, making it an easy shop to visit with your dog.

154.description: Oliveira Brava in Porto Covo, Sines, welcomes up to three dogs per stay with no additional fee. Dogs may stay inside the small holiday houses, although small or medium breeds are recommended because of the limited space.

155.description: Alma-Rio Zêzere in Alqueidão near Tomar welcomes dogs of any size indoors and in outdoor areas. Dogs may stay in the accommodation, but cannot be left alone in the dome or tent because of the structure's fragility. A peaceful riverside retreat for a break with your dog.

156.description: Cape Cruiser, departing from Porto da Baleeira in Sagres, accepts small and medium-sized dogs on its dolphin- and whale-watching boat trips. Whether a dog can board depends on passenger numbers, sea conditions and safety requirements. Confirm your dog’s acceptance when booking so the operator can assess the conditions for your trip.

157.description: Monte da Casa Telhada in Ademas, Santiago do Cacém, welcomes up to two dogs of any size subject to prior confirmation, normally without a fee. The property is rented exclusively and has 3.5 hectares of private fenced land. Dogs must be supervised, cannot enter bedrooms or climb onto beds or sofas, and owners must collect waste.

158.description: Casa das Mós between Amarante and Marco de Canaveses accepts up to three dogs of any size, subject to advance approval and a fee of €50 per dog. Dogs may stay in guest rooms but cannot access the pool or surrounding pool area. Bring their beds, food and bowls, and collect waste.

159.description: Refúgio do Vidoeiro in Vila do Gerês accepts up to two small or medium dogs per stay, including in guest rooms. A food bowl, water bowl and private terrace are provided, and a €5 fee applies for the entire stay. Dogs must not be left alone for more than four hours; owners should provide pet details and respect quiet hours from 9 pm to 8 am.

160.description: Doppo Gelateria on Praça do Comércio in Coimbra welcomes dogs on its terrace. It serves artisan ice cream and speciality coffee, with flavours ranging from classics to creative combinations. Dog-friendly ice cream flavours may occasionally be available.

161.description: São Brás do Regedouro – Turismo na Aldeia near Évora welcomes dogs of any size indoors, in guest rooms and communal areas. There is no fixed number limit, although up to three dogs are recommended for everyone's comfort. A single €15 fee applies for the entire stay.

162.description: Puro Dão Hotel & Spa in Nelas welcomes one dog weighing up to 10 kg per room, subject to availability. The fee is €45 for the first night and €30 per subsequent night. Dogs may stay in rooms but cannot be left alone and must be on leads. Restaurants, bars and social areas are off limits; bring the legally required pet documents.

163.description: Beach House Babylon in Torreira welcomes dogs of any size in guest rooms, up to two per room or six when booking the entire house. The fee is €10 per dog per stay. Dogs cannot use the pool or remain unsupervised, and owners are responsible for any damage.

164.description: Ria Surf House in Ovar welcomes dogs indoors and in guest rooms. Facing the Ria de Aveiro, the property has four bedrooms, living and dining space, kitchen, garden and outdoor pool. Praia do Areinho is nearby, and Praia do Furadouro is around three kilometres away.

165.description: Moleiro da Costa Má in Silva Escura, Sever do Vouga, welcomes dogs indoors and in guest rooms. An indicated fee of €15 per pet per stay applies; confirm acceptance when booking. The rural property has a garden, terrace, seasonal outdoor pool and access to a riverside area.

166.description: Do Largo in the historic centre of Évora welcomes dogs indoors and on its shaded terrace. The café and restaurant serves breakfast, brunch and lunch, offering a convenient break during a walk through Évora.

167.description: CO-OP Layday in downtown Lisbon is a café and brunch spot where dogs of all sizes are welcome indoors. There is no outdoor terrace, but the café provides water bowls and dog treats, making it a convenient stop while exploring the city centre with your dog.

168.description: Herdade da Terra Rica – The Club in Alcácer do Sal welcomes either one large dog or up to two small or medium dogs per house, without a pet fee. Dogs can stay indoors and explore the grounds under their owners' responsibility. They must be on a lead near the pool and cannot swim in it.

169.description: Parque Ribeirinho de Silves is a free riverside park beside the Arade River in Silves, with green spaces, a cycle path, a playground and a sports area. It is a pleasant place to walk your dog on a lead, with open space and water available. Keep your dog supervised and always clean up after it.

170.description: Vale Luís Neto – Retiro do Caldeirão in Salir, near Loulé, accepts up to three dogs of any size with no extra pet fee. Dogs cannot stay inside the bedrooms, but each of the three holiday houses has a private patio or garden where they can remain. Surrounded by the countryside of the Serra do Caldeirão, it is a peaceful accommodation option for visitors travelling with dogs in inland Algarve.

171.description: Monte Val Murtinhais in Santa Cruz, Santiago do Cacém, welcomes up to two dogs of any size without an extra fee. Dogs can stay indoors and in guest rooms, provided they are sociable with people and other animals. Water is available.

172.description: Monte do Melo near Montemor-o-Novo welcomes dogs of any size for an additional €10 per day. Dogs cannot enter bedrooms or the pool or climb onto sofas, and owners must collect waste. The estate is fenced, but the fence may not contain small or adventurous dogs. It offers ample outdoor space for groups travelling with dogs in the Alentejo.

173.description: Moinho da Alma in Porches, in the municipality of Lagoa, welcomes dogs in its accommodation without size restrictions, a stated limit on the number of dogs or an additional pet fee. Dogs may stay in the room but should not climb on beds or sofas; guests whose pets are used to doing so should bring protective covers. Owners must clean up after their dogs, respect other guests and take responsibility for damage. It is a flexible dog-friendly base for exploring the Algarve.

174.description: Casa d'Abó Anica in Malhadas, near Miranda do Douro, welcomes dogs indoors, in guest rooms and in outdoor areas. Water is available. The restored agrotourism buildings offer a stay connected to the history and traditions of the Terras de Miranda.

175.description: The western end of Praia de Alvor, in the municipality of Portimão, is a wide, non-concession beach area suitable for walks with your dog beside the sea. Rules may vary during the bathing season, so always check local signage before entering with a dog. Keep your pet supervised and clean up after it.

176.description: Quinta das Pirâmides in Telhado, Vila Nova de Famalicão, accepts dogs in guest rooms subject to the accommodation type. The allowed size and number depend on the reserved unit. There is a charge of €50 per pet per stay, and dogs must not be left alone in room-style accommodation.

177.description: Quinta Alto do Rio in Cinfães welcomes dogs indoors and in guest rooms, without size or number restrictions and with no additional pet fee. The rural accommodation near the Douro suits guests travelling with several dogs.

178.description: Recantos D’Almerinda in Pombal welcomes up to four dogs of any size, currently without an extra fee. They can stay indoors and in guest rooms, but must be on a lead in the garden and shared areas. Dogs cannot enter the pool or jacuzzi, and owners must collect waste.

179.description: Casas de Juromenha in Alandroal welcomes up to two dogs of any size per stay for a €30 fee. Dogs can stay indoors and explore the surrounding countryside, using leads when needed. Do not use house towels, blankets or pillows for pets; take dogs outside the accommodation grounds for toilet breaks.

180.description: Quinta do Vianna in Mesão Frio allows one small dog in guest accommodation without a fee; the dog must not be left alone in the room. For wine tastings or wine lunches without an overnight stay, the limits are three small dogs, two medium dogs or one large dog. Owners are responsible for damage and extra cleaning.

181.description: Praia da Angrinha in Ferragudo, in the municipality of Lagoa, is a non-concession beach beside the Arade River estuary where visitors may bring dogs unless local signs say otherwise. The beach is near Forte de São João do Arade and Ferragudo’s traditional fishing area. It is a pleasant place for a waterside walk with your dog, provided you follow the posted rules, supervise your pet and clean up after it.

182.description: Raízes no Rossio on Largo do Rossio in Vila Nova de Milfontes welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace, on a lead. The relaxed restaurant combines Asian, Mediterranean and Portuguese flavours, including bao buns, sharing dishes and vegetarian options.

183.description: Lupita Pizzaria on Rua de São Paulo in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors. Known for naturally fermented pizzas and natural wines, it is an option for dining with your dog in the Cais do Sodré area. No size restrictions are recorded, so check with the restaurant if needed.

184.description: Praia INATEL in São João da Caparica has a non-concessioned area where dogs are tolerated. Respect other beach users, check signs and seasonal rules, supervise your dog and collect waste.

185.description: A Casa da Margem in Montargil welcomes dogs of any size and number without an additional fee. Dogs can stay in guest bedrooms but must not climb onto beds or sofas. The spacious grounds have direct reservoir access via steps and a small beach, appealing to dogs that enjoy swimming.

186.description: Canto da Planície in Conceição, Ourique, welcomes dogs of any size without an extra fee. They can accompany guests around the house, with owners asked to use common sense regarding bedrooms and the swimming pool. A peaceful rural stay in the Alentejo.

187.description: Vale Moreno House in Reguengos de Monsaraz welcomes up to two small dogs. They may sleep in guest bedrooms in their own beds, but must not be left alone. The fee is €10 per pet per day or €50 per week. The garden is fully fenced, but dogs cannot enter the pool or jacuzzi and must be on leads in shared dining areas.

188.description: Parque Canino do Jardim das Tílias in Linda-a-Velha is a small fenced dog park where dogs can exercise off lead. It has a double-gated entrance, drinking water, a bench for owners and a simple obstacle course, making it a convenient spot for play and socialisation in a controlled space.

189.description: Sleep & Nature Hotel in Lavre, Montemor-o-Novo, welcomes pets indoors and in guest rooms. From September to June, the first pet stays free and the normal fee applies only to the second; in July and August the indicated fee is €30 per pet per night. The hotel has terraces, a spa, restaurant and indoor and outdoor pools; confirm pet access to these facilities.

190.description: Tapada de Coelheiros in Igrejinha, Arraiolos, welcomes dogs in its shop and tasting and dining spaces, but not inside the winery for hygiene reasons. When a visit includes more than one dog, acceptance depends on their size and the wine tourism team's assessment.

191.description: Monte da Freira in Bencatel, Vila Viçosa, welcomes up to two small dogs indoors, including guest bedrooms, without an extra fee. The rural property has a garden, outdoor pool, barbecue and games room.

192.description: Monte das Mariolas in Castelo de Vide welcomes dogs of any size inside the accommodation. The usual limit is two dogs, although more may be accepted on request. Any pet fee varies according to the stay; confirm when booking.

193.description: Dungle Club, on Estrada das Pereiras in Quarteira, is a social space for dogs and their people. Its fenced area lets dogs run, play and socialise safely off-lead, while owners can relax in the lounge, bar and coffee area. The venue also offers dog washing, grooming, events and activities, with water available for dogs. Check opening times, entry rules and conditions before visiting.

194.description: A Padaria Portuguesa – Alcântara in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace, subject to applicable legal restrictions. It is a convenient place for breakfast, a light meal or a coffee break with your dog in Alcântara, with indoor seating available when the weather is less inviting.

195.description: A Padaria Portuguesa – Alfragide, in the municipality of Amadora, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace, subject to applicable legal restrictions. It is a practical bakery and café for breakfast, a light meal or coffee with your dog, with a choice of seating inside or outside.

196.description: Casa Valentina in Pedrógão, Vidigueira, accepts up to two small or medium dogs without an extra fee. Dogs cannot stay in bedrooms or climb onto beds and sofas. The Alentejo villa has two bedrooms, a terrace and an outdoor pool.

197.description: Souldough Pizza in central Cascais welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace. Known for naturally fermented pizza dough, it is a relaxed place for a meal with your dog throughout the year. Booking a table may be advisable at busy times.

198.description: Quinta Alto da Capela in Setúbal welcomes up to four pets of any size without an additional fee. Dogs may stay indoors but cannot be left alone or climb onto beds and sofas. Food and water bowls are provided. The outdoor area is walled, and dogs may use the swimming pool from March to October under owner supervision.

199.description: Pacová Comida e Cultura in Benfica, Lisbon, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The venue combines a café, Brazilian-inspired food and cultural activities, making it possible to enjoy breakfast, lunch or an event with your dog without being limited to outdoor seating.

200.description: Assossego House – Gerês in Rio Caldo, Terras de Bouro, welcomes pets indoors if they sleep in their own beds brought by owners. There is a €30 fee per pet and a €200 deposit at check-in. Pets cannot climb onto beds or enter the pool, and must not roam unsupervised because the property is not fenced.

201.description: A Padaria Portuguesa – Palmeiras in Oeiras welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on the terrace, subject to applicable legal restrictions. Water is available at the entrance. It is a convenient bakery and café for breakfast, a snack or a coffee break with your dog.

202.description: Residente, on Rua Alexandre Herculano in central Cascais, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and outside, including on the terrace. The restaurant specialises in sharing plates with wine and cocktails, featuring dishes such as avocado hummus, Mediterranean burrata, Iberian ham croquettes and Korean-style fried chicken. It is an inviting option for dining with your dog in Cascais.

203.description: My’oMeu, on Rua Conselheiro Sebastião Teles in central Faro, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. Due to the small dining room, only small dogs are accepted inside, while dogs of all sizes are welcome outdoors. The restaurant combines Polish and Mediterranean cooking, including pierogi, freshly made pasta, seasonal dishes and vegetarian options. It is an inviting place for lunch or dinner with your dog in Faro.

204.description: Bel’mare, at Praia de Faro, welcomes calm, well-behaved dogs of any size indoors and outside, with water available for pets. Facing the Atlantic, it combines a restaurant, bar and rooftop. Its menu includes fish, seafood, meat, poke bowls and sharing dishes. The venue also operates a beach concession with food and drink service, making it a convenient stop with your dog by the sea in Faro.

205.description: Sal’mare, at Praia de Faro, welcomes calm, well-behaved dogs of any size both indoors and on its terrace. Water is available for pets. During the day it has a relaxed beach-club atmosphere, while in the evening it becomes a steakhouse focused on premium cuts of meat. With a terrace beside the sand, it is easy to combine a meal with a walk along Faro Beach with your dog.

206.description: Spot Local in Moncarapacho is both a café and accommodation welcoming well-behaved pets, subject to advance arrangement. Animals are permitted in the café and guest rooms but must stay on a lead in the café and while exploring the grounds. A fee of €20 per pet per night applies. It is a useful pet-friendly option for a coffee or an overnight stay in the eastern Algarve.

208.description: O Poço Novo, in São João das Lampas near Sintra, welcomes dogs on its terrace. The restaurant serves a varied menu including picanha, squid and prawn skewers, octopus à lagareiro, moqueca, homemade desserts and vegetarian options. It is an informal place for an outdoor meal with your dog in the Sintra countryside.

209.description: DOMA Portugal in Mafra is a dog-friendly countryside club and hotel where dogs can stay in rooms and glamping units, provided the pet option is added when booking. Set among roughly 18 hectares of pine forest about 30 minutes from Lisbon, the property offers accommodation, a pool, spa, dining and leisure areas. It also has a dedicated dog playground, making it attractive for a nature getaway with your dog.

210.description: Amarello Hotel Praia Santo André, near the lagoon and beach in Santiago do Cacém, welcomes pets weighing up to 20 kg. They may stay in guest rooms, accompany owners at breakfast and other meals, and use permitted hotel areas on a lead. A non-refundable fee of €25 per stay applies.

211.description: Toska Hamburgueria, on Rua João Augusto Saias in Olhão, welcomes dogs on its terrace, where water is available. Known for its handmade burgers, it also offers wraps, bruschetta, salads, bowls and vegetarian and vegan choices. It is an informal place for a relaxed meal with your dog in Olhão.

212.description: Tavira Plaza is a shopping centre in Tavira where dogs are welcome indoors when accompanied and kept on a non-retractable lead no longer than one metre. The centre has shops, food outlets and services, making it possible to run errands with your dog. Dogs classified as potentially dangerous must also comply with the legal muzzle requirements. It is particularly useful on hot or rainy days.

213.description: Hortacasa Portugal at Quinta do Pedro in Santiago do Cacém welcomes dogs and other pets without a fixed size or number limit. They can stay in guest rooms and explore outdoor areas accompanied by their owners, but cannot enter the swimming pool. The charge is €25 per pet per stay. The property also has a shared pool and barbecue area.

214.description: Herdade do Carregouçal in Odemira welcomes dogs in almost all parts of its rural accommodation, except the breakfast area. This working-farm setting offers a peaceful stay with your dog in the Alentejo.

215.description: Hola Torito, on Avenida 5 de Outubro in Olhão, is a Mexican restaurant welcoming dogs on its terrace. Water is available for pets, which must remain on a lead. The menu includes tacos, nachos, guacamole, burritos and other Mexican favourites, along with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. A lively choice for lunch or dinner with your dog in central Olhão.

216.description: NATSU Tavira, on Travessa José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace as long as they remain on a lead. The Japanese-inspired menu goes beyond sushi, with ramen, yakisoba, gyoza, bao buns, donburi, vegetarian options and Asian-style desserts. Its central location makes it an easy place to combine a walk through Tavira with a meal outside alongside your dog.

217.description: Primitivo Tavira, on Praça Dr. António Padinha in central Tavira, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Dogs must remain on a lead, and water is available. Fire is central to the restaurant’s cooking, with grilled meat, fish, seafood and vegetarian dishes on a seasonal menu. It is a distinctive place for lunch or dinner with your dog in Tavira.

218.description: Praia da Almagreira in Ferrel, Peniche, is a wild Atlantic beach north of Baleal, known for its wide sands and reddish cliffs. It can be a scenic place for a walk with your dog, but take care on dirt access roads and near unstable cliffs. Follow beach signs and seasonal restrictions.

219.description: Quiosque da Alfarrobeira, in Parque Urbano da Alfarrobeira in Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace, with water available for pets. Surrounded by walking paths, lawns and recreational areas, the kiosk-bar is a handy place for a drink or a break during a walk with your dog. There is also a fenced dog park nearby.

220.description: Parque Canino da Alfarrobeira, within Parque Urbano da Alfarrobeira in central Albufeira, is a fenced dog area where dogs can run and play off-lead. The enclosure has exercise obstacles, open space, shade and benches for owners. Entry is free. The wider urban park also offers walking paths, a fitness area, a playground, picnic facilities and a bar. It is a practical place for off-lead exercise and socialisation in Albufeira.

221.description: Frente ao Mar, on Rua Mascarenhas Gregório in Armação de Pêra, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace. The café and bar serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and drinks, with burgers, salads, sandwiches, crêpes and ice cream among the options. Its spacious, shady terrace makes it a convenient stop with your dog close to the seafront.

222.description: Parque Dom Carlos I in central Caldas da Rainha is a romantic public garden with flat paths, mature trees and shaded green spaces. It offers a pleasant setting for a relaxed walk with your dog.

223.description: Cascata da Contradinha, also called Cascata de Santiago, is a small waterfall near Santiago dos Velhos in the municipality of Arruda dos Vinhos. Fed by Ribeira do Boição, it is especially picturesque after rain, when water falls into a small pool surrounded by vegetation. A short dirt track from Rua da Contradinha and a walking trail lead to the waterfall. It is a peaceful nature outing with your dog near Lisbon; take care on wet paths.

224.description: Sambé Beach, at Praia de Santo António in Vila Real de Santo António, allows dogs on its outdoor terrace. The beach restaurant and bar is a place to enjoy a meal, a drink or a break close to the sand with your dog beside you. It offers an easy option for dog owners exploring this part of the eastern Algarve.

225.description: Originato, on Rua José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs indoors provided they remain on a lead. Close to the river and the ferry departure point for Tavira Island, the café serves breakfast, brunch and light meals, including bagels, pancakes, bowls, eggs, smoothies and coffee. It is a convenient stop with your dog before or after exploring Tavira’s historic centre and riverside.

226.description: Daiya Sushi Tavira, at Fábrica Balsense in Tavira, welcomes dogs both indoors and outside. Alongside sushi, the restaurant offers contemporary Asian dishes, hot meals, creative combinations, cocktails and sharing plates. Its terrace is inviting on warm days, while indoor seating makes it an option throughout the year. A useful dog-friendly choice for lunch or dinner in Tavira.

227.description: Liberty: brunch, coffee & books, on Rua da Esperança in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. Combining brunch, speciality coffee and a small bookshop, it is a relaxed place to eat, drink or read with your dog in the Santos neighbourhood. The menu includes egg dishes, toast and vegetarian options.

228.description: Antisocial, in Guia near Albufeira, welcomes dogs indoors. Describing itself as a concept rather than simply a brunch spot or coffee shop, it serves focaccia sandwiches, house-made pastries and speciality coffee in a laid-back setting. It is an appealing choice for a meal or coffee with your dog in Guia, without needing to sit outside.

229.description: Café Formosa, on Rua José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs indoors. Specialising in speciality coffee, it also serves breakfast and light lunches, including focaccia, pastries, fresh juices and matcha, with vegan options available. It is a relaxed place for coffee or a bite to eat with your dog near Tavira’s historic centre.

230.description: Liberty: food, coffee & wine, in Parede near Cascais, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and always has water bowls available for them. The friendly café and restaurant specialises in brunch, speciality coffee and light meals throughout the day. It is a welcoming place for a break with your dog on the Cascais coast.

231.description: Cotidiano Marquês de Pombal, near Avenida da Liberdade and Parque Eduardo VII in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The café offers all-day brunch, breakfast, lunch and coffee in a relaxed setting. Its central location makes it an easy stop with your dog before or after a walk through Lisbon.

232.description: Cotidiano Chiado, in central Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The café serves all-day brunch, breakfast and lunch dishes such as pancakes, toast, bowls, salads, pastries and juices, along with freshly prepared bread. It is a relaxed place for a break with your dog while exploring Chiado.

233.description: 8 Marvila, in the Marvila district of Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace. This creative venue brings together restaurants, bars, shops, galleries and events, making it an appealing place for a walk, a meal or a drink with your dog in an informal atmosphere. Individual businesses may have their own conditions.

234.description: Sense of Coffee, in Parque das Nações, Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace. This speciality coffee shop is a convenient option for coffee and a break with your dog in the riverside neighbourhood, with no size restriction specified.

235.description: Steakhouse Mar de Carne in Silveira, near Torres Vedras, welcomes dogs indoors, with a maximum of two animals. Specialising in meat dishes, it offers a place to enjoy a meal with your dog in the Lisbon district, provided the restaurant’s two-dog indoor limit is respected.

236.description: Praia das Furnas–Rio near Vila Nova de Milfontes has an officially designated area for dogs upstream from the main beach. Established as a dog-friendly bathing area in 2021, it lets owners enjoy the sand and Mira River with their dogs while following local hygiene and safety rules.

237.description: Casa do Guarda Rios in Fornos de Algodres welcomes animals indoors without stated size or number restrictions. The property has outdoor areas and a jacuzzi, offering a peaceful stay with pets in the Guarda district.

238.description: La Vie Caldas da Rainha shopping centre allows dogs and cats in common areas and participating shops. Dogs must wear a collar or harness with a non-retractable lead no longer than one metre. Pets are excluded from the food court, children's area, baby-changing facilities and other marked spaces. Follow shop signs for individual access.

239.description: Smash Burger in Lisbon welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. Specialising in burgers, the restaurant offers a convenient place for a casual lunch, dinner or quick stop with your dog, with a choice of seating inside or outside depending on the weather.

240.description: My Açaí in Alvalade, Lisbon, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The café is a convenient stop for an açaí bowl, a snack or a quick bite while exploring this part of the city with your dog. Indoor and outdoor seating make it practical at different times of year.

241.description: Old Times Bistro, Bar & Coffee in Manta Rota, in the municipality of Vila Real de Santo António, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Offering café, bar and restaurant service, it is a convenient place for breakfast, a meal or a drink with your dog. You can choose between indoor and outdoor seating when visiting Manta Rota.

242.description: Sem Palavras, at Mercado de Alvalade in Lisbon, welcomes dogs on its terrace. This Portuguese restaurant and seafood house serves sharing plates, shellfish, steaks and traditional dishes in a relaxed neighbourhood setting. It is a good option for lunch or dinner outdoors with your dog in Alvalade.

243.description: Green Bistrot in Guimarães welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The restaurant focuses on healthy vegetarian, vegan and macrobiotic dishes made with fresh local ingredients, offering a plant-based meal with your dog.

244.description: Primo Basílico Pinsa, on Avenida de Paris in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace. The Italian restaurant serves pizzas, pasta, risotto and other dishes suited to a relaxed lunch or dinner. Being able to choose between indoor and outdoor seating makes it a convenient place to eat with your dog in Lisbon throughout the year.

245.description: Mercearia do Prato in Arruda dos Vinhos combines a café, bistro, gourmet shop and gallery, welcoming dogs indoors and in outdoor areas. Dogs must remain on a short lead or inside a carrier and cannot move freely among customers. They are not allowed in service areas, kitchens or places with exposed food. Entry or continued access may be refused if an animal’s behaviour or hygiene disrupts the restaurant. It is a dog-friendly place for a meal provided these safety and courtesy rules are respected.

246.description: Oporto Lemon Farm in Valpedre, Penafiel, welcomes dogs of any size and allows them in the swimming pool. A €25 supplement applies per booking. Surrounded by nature and lemon trees, this rural accommodation is around 30 minutes from Porto.

247.description: Parque Marechal Carmona in Cascais welcomes dogs and offers lawns, tree-lined paths, ponds, seating areas and picnic facilities near the town centre. A café with a terrace is located beside the lake. Because the park is home to birds and other animals, dogs should remain under control throughout the visit. It is an attractive green space for a walk with your dog in Cascais.

248.description: Cerdeira – Home for Creativity in a schist village in Serra da Lousã offers six pet-friendly houses where dogs and cats of any size can stay indoors with their owners. Pets must always be accompanied and cannot be left alone in the accommodation. The restored village setting combines traditional architecture, art and modern comforts around nine kilometres from Lousã.

249.description: Abigail’s Café in Lagos is a café and bakery welcoming well-behaved, sociable dogs indoors. It serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and speciality coffee, focusing on homemade food and locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. The menu includes juices, smoothies, and vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free choices. It is a good option for a light, relaxed meal with your dog in central Lagos.

250.description: Blade, on Praça Dom Luís I near Cais do Sodré in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The restaurant specialises in steak served with different sides and sauces in an informal setting. Close to Mercado da Ribeira and the riverfront, it is a convenient place for a meal with your dog in central Lisbon.

251.description: At Street Coffee on Rua de Santa Teresa near the Clérigos Tower in Porto welcomes dogs indoors. Inspired by the relaxed creative atmosphere of Los Angeles' Atwater Village, it is a convenient speciality coffee stop with your dog in the city centre.

252.description: At Street Coffee on Rua da Senhora da Luz in Porto's Foz do Douro neighbourhood welcomes dogs indoors. It is a convenient speciality coffee stop before or after a seaside walk, without needing to rely on outdoor tables.

253.description: O Vitó, in Linda-a-Velha near Oeiras, welcomes dogs only on its covered outdoor terrace, which is sheltered from the wind. Known for homestyle Portuguese cooking, the restaurant serves traditional dishes, sharing plates and snails in season. It is a practical place for a meal with your dog, but dogs are not permitted indoors.

254.description: Quinta da Dourada in Portalegre, within Serra de São Mamede Natural Park, welcomes up to three pets of any size per house. Pets may stay in the accommodation and use the estate's permitted areas but cannot enter the pool. They can be left alone in the room if they do not disturb others, and guests are responsible for any damage.

255.description: AREL – Padaria & Cozinha in Aljezur welcomes dogs indoors. Located on Rua 25 de Abril, it combines an artisan bakery with a kitchen, serving sourdough bread, pastries and food throughout the day. It is a handy stop for breakfast, lunch or coffee with your dog in the centre of the village, especially for visitors exploring Aljezur and the Vicentine Coast.

256.description: Salema Tours, based at Salema Beach in the municipality of Vila do Bispo, allows dogs on boat trips when sea conditions permit. The company offers dolphin-watching trips, visits to coastal caves and Benagil Cave, fishing excursions and kayak hire. If taking a dog aboard is not advisable, the animal may be left ashore in the care of the animal-loving team while its owners enjoy the trip. This offers a distinctive way to explore the Algarve coast without leaving your dog out of the experience.

257.description: O Grande Museu das Casinhas de Bonecas on Rua do Alferes Malheiro in Porto welcomes dogs indoors on a lead and offers water. Set in a former garage, the museum displays more than 60 detailed miniature Victorian houses, farms and workshops, alongside material about reuse and sustainability.

258.description: The Passadiços da Póvoa de Santa Iria boardwalks, in the municipality of Vila Franca de Xira, welcome dogs provided they remain on a lead. Following the Tagus estuary waterfront, the flat walking and cycling paths offer river views and opportunities for birdwatching. Water is available along the route, and there is a terrace where visitors can stop with their dogs. A pleasant waterside walk near Lisbon.

259.description: CoolAres, in Colares near Sintra, welcomes dogs indoors and on its spacious terrace. The team is friendly towards visiting dogs and provides water for them. The menu includes all-day brunch, internationally inspired dishes and vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. It is a relaxed place to eat with your dog between the Sintra hills and nearby beaches.

260.description: Passadiços da Barrinha de Esmoriz in Ovar offer a walk of roughly six kilometres beside Barrinha de Esmoriz, also known as Lagoa de Paramos. This coastal lagoon is part of the Natura 2000 network and is important for birds. The wooden boardwalks offer a scenic nature walk with your dog.

261.description: Copenhagen Coffee Lab, on Avenida Álvares Cabral near Estrela in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors. This bakery and café serves speciality coffee, freshly baked bread and pastries, as well as breakfast and brunch dishes. With indoor tables and a location close to Jardim da Estrela, it is a convenient place for coffee or a light meal with your dog.

262.description: Gleba Almada Centro on Avenida Dom Nuno Álvares Pereira welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. The bakery and café serves fresh bread, pastries, speciality coffee and breakfast or brunch options throughout the day.

263.description: Ramen Break on Praça Conde de Agrolongo in Braga welcomes dogs indoors and provides water. This relaxed restaurant and cocktail bar specialises in Japanese-inspired ramen with carefully prepared broths and different toppings.

264.description: Benedito Brunch & Restaurante in central Barcelos welcomes dogs indoors and provides water. The menu includes brunch sets, pancakes, bowls, pastries, speciality coffee and fresh juices, making it a convenient breakfast or lunch stop with your dog.

265.description: Praia Fluvial de Zebreiros in Foz do Sousa, Gondomar, allows dogs in the area beside the supervised bathing zone. On the right bank of the Douro near the Sousa confluence, it has sand, access facilities and a café terrace. Respect the designated beach boundaries.

266.description: NAUTK Restaurant & Rooftop, at Praia da Bafureira in Parede, near Cascais, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace. Dogs must remain accompanied by their owners and behave appropriately in the restaurant. Overlooking the Atlantic, the venue combines a restaurant, bar and rooftop with Portuguese- and Mediterranean-inspired food, fresh fish, seafood, meat and cocktails. It is a scenic choice for lunch, dinner or sunset drinks with your dog on the Cascais coast.

267.description: À Lagardère in Samora Correia, Benavente, welcomes dogs indoors and provides water. It also has a fenced outdoor area. Chef Joana Serafim Candeias creates seasonal dishes that combine local Ribatejo ingredients with contemporary ideas.

268.description: Lagoa de Santo André in Santiago do Cacém offers scenic walks with dogs among the lagoon, dunes and Atlantic coastline. Part of the Santo André and Sancha Lagoons Nature Reserve, the area is important for birdlife. Follow local signs and access rules, particularly during the bathing season.

269.description: Belém – Brunch Bar in Tavira welcomes small and medium-sized dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The all-day concept combines brunch, coffee and cocktails, with options for breakfast, lunch or a relaxed break. Being able to choose between indoor and outdoor seating makes it a practical place to eat with your dog in Tavira, Algarve.

270.description: Espressolab Baixa, on Rua da Prata in central Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace, with no extra restrictions specified. Located in the Baixa district, it combines speciality coffee with an all-day breakfast and brunch menu, including toast and egg dishes. A convenient stop with your dog while exploring Lisbon’s historic centre.

271.description: Earth Shop & Café in Carvoeiro, in the municipality of Lagoa, welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, with a maximum of three animals. If a dog barks indoors, staff may ask that it stay outside. Overlooking the sea, the café and shop serves breakfast and brunch throughout the day, including bowls, wraps, salads, smoothies and coffee. It is a convenient dog-friendly spot for breakfast or lunch in central Carvoeiro.

272.description: Amaterasu Pateo do Sushi in Algés, near Oeiras, welcomes dogs on its terrace. Known for fusion sushi, it serves starters, sashimi, traditional and creative sushi selections and a carefully chosen wine list. It is an inviting option for an outdoor lunch or dinner with your dog in Algés.

273.description: Koala, in Jardim do Eucaliptal de Benfica in Lisbon, welcomes dogs both indoors and on its terrace, with water available. The café, bar and restaurant has a spacious outdoor area amid greenery, making it a pleasant place for a meal, coffee or a break during a walk. There is also a dog park in the same garden.

274.description: Bons Tempos Restaurante e Petiscos on Rua de Santa Sofia in Vila Real welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace, with a limit of two dogs per visit. The menu combines Portuguese regional dishes such as cod with cornbread and rojões with contemporary touches. A garden area is available in warmer months.

275.description: Jardim Nativo, in Parque Urbano de Miraflores in Algés, welcomes dogs on its large outdoor terrace and provides water for pets. Surrounded by green spaces, the restaurant serves breakfast, brunch, lunch, afternoon snacks and dinner, with picnic options in the garden. A fenced dog park nearby makes it easy to combine a meal with outdoor exercise for your dog.

276.description: Maria Limão, on Rua da Graça in Lisbon, welcomes dogs indoors and provides water for them. Known for brunch, pancakes, crêpes and homemade lemonade, it also serves toast, bowls and vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free choices. It is a welcoming place for breakfast or brunch with your dog in the Graça neighbourhood.

277.description: Pátio – Cozinha Portuguesa, at LX Factory in Alcântara, Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its spacious terrace. The restaurant serves relaxed Portuguese cooking, including sharing plates and dishes inspired by traditional flavours. Its informal atmosphere makes it an attractive place for lunch, dinner or an evening meal with your dog in one of Lisbon’s creative districts.

278.description: Parque Canino da Gafanha da Encarnação in Ílhavo is a fenced dog park on Rua da Estufa, opened in 2023. Dogs can play and exercise off lead in an ample area with activity obstacles and places for owners to rest.

279.description: Espressolab Castilho, on Rua Castilho in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes indoors and on its terrace. Alongside speciality coffee, it offers a food menu and all-day breakfast choices, making it suitable for a quick coffee or a longer brunch with your dog in central Lisbon.

280.description: Espressolab Estrela, on Calçada da Estrela in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of any size indoors and on its terrace, with no additional restrictions specified. Dedicated to speciality coffee, it offers a relaxed place for a break with your dog while exploring the Estrela neighbourhood, with the choice of indoor or outdoor seating.

281.description: Hotel Meira in Vila Praia de Âncora, Caminha, welcomes pets in guest rooms and most communal areas, except dining spaces. Dogs must be on a lead in shared areas. The fee is €20 per animal per night, and pets must be declared when booking. Balcony or terrace rooms may be prioritised where available, and pet beds can be rented. Beach access rules vary by season; the Praia das Crianças area is a nearby walking option during the bathing season.

282.description: Linha d’Água, in Jardim Amália Rodrigues in Lisbon, welcomes dogs of all sizes on its terrace, with drinking water available for pets. Beside a lake and surrounded by greenery, the café serves salads, quiche, hot dishes, toast, wraps, pastries and fresh juices throughout the day. It is a pleasant place to relax with your dog in a central Lisbon park.

283.description: ARQO, in Parque Urbano Gonçalo Ribeiro Telles at Praça de Espanha in Lisbon, welcomes dogs on its terrace, where water is available for them. Set within a spacious green park, the café and bar serves breakfast, light meals, toast, wraps, salads and cocktails. Its outdoor seating is especially convenient for a break during a walk with your dog; dogs are not permitted indoors.

284.description: Parque Canino de Quarteira, in the municipality of Loulé, is a fenced dog park where dogs can run freely in a safe enclosure. Opened in May 2026 and located beside the Continente supermarket, it has equipment, areas for spending time with dogs and signs explaining the rules. It is a practical off-leash option in Quarteira where dogs can run, play and socialise in a purpose-built space, with easy access during a walk around town.

285.description: Bambina Café in Algés, in the municipality of Oeiras, welcomes dogs indoors and on its terrace. This relaxed, family-friendly brunch café serves pancakes, waffles, bowls, salads, sandwiches and coffee.
